# WhichMuseum

> > WhichMuseum is a comprehensive global museum directory featuring thousands of museums, exhibitions, and cultural attractions across Europe, the Middle East, and beyond, with curated guides, discount information, and visitor resources.

WhichMuseum helps travelers and culture enthusiasts discover museums worldwide, offering detailed directories for major destinations like France (2878+ museums), Switzerland (861+ museums), UAE (100+ museums), Turkey (357+ museums), and South Africa. The platform provides exhibition schedules, museum passes, discounts, and curated rankings to enhance cultural tourism experiences.

## Key Topics

- Museum directories
- Cultural attractions
- Museum discounts and passes
- Exhibitions and events
- Europe museums
- UAE museums (Dubai, Abu Dhabi)
- Tourist guides
- Heritage sites
- Museum of the Future
- Burj Khalifa
- Qasr Al Watan Palace
- Dubai Aquarium & Underwater Zoo
- Swiss museums
- French museums
- Best museums rankings

## Major Museum Destinations

- [France: Discover all 2878+ Museums, Exhibitions & Discounts](https://static.whichmuseum.com/place/france-11): Complete directory of 2878+ French museums in Paris & beyond
- [Switzerland: Discover all 861+ Museums, Exhibitions & Discounts](https://static.whichmuseum.com/place/switzerland-10437): Complete directory of 861+ Swiss museums including Chillon Castle
- [United Arab Emirates: Discover all 100+ Museums, Exhibitions & Discounts](https://static.whichmuseum.com/place/united-arab-emirates-10409): Complete directory of 100+ UAE museums in Dubai, Abu Dhabi & more
- [Turkey: Discover all 357+ Museums, Exhibitions & Discounts](https://static.whichmuseum.com/place/turkey-10440): Complete directory of 357+ Turkish museums in Istanbul & other cities
